description: Enumerate the well-known intrinsics (`%X%` notations) used in the spec, with each one's probable defining clause (chosen by a title-substring heuristic — see `matched_on` per hit). For the canonical 262 well-known intrinsics table, read `clause.get { id: 'sec-well-known-intrinsic-objects' }` directly.

edition.description: Edition within the chosen spec. ECMA-262: es2016 … es2026, main. ECMA-402: es2016 … es2026, main. Aliases: latest, draft, next.

filter.description: Case-insensitive substring filter on the intrinsic name (bare, e.g. 'object.prototype').

spec.description: Which TC39 spec to read: '262' (core language, default) or '402' (Internationalization API).

name: spec.well_known_intrinsics
title: Well-known intrinsics
